The message was dated forty years earlier: “If anyone finds this, tell my sister I made it home.” Beneath the words was a name Mara recognized from the village cemetery. That evening, the lighthouse sent its steady light across the water.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还沉在深蓝色的梦里。路灯把潮湿的街道照得微微发亮，昨夜的雨水汇成细小的水洼，映着稀疏的灯火。远处传来清洁车缓慢的声响，几家早餐铺已经升起白色蒸汽。高楼之间，偶尔有一扇窗亮着，像有人也在等待黎明。公交车空空驶过路口，树叶被风轻轻翻动。此时的城市不再喧闹，却并未真正沉睡；它只是放慢脚步，让疲惫的人休息，也让早起的人悄悄开始新的一天。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version of that problem.\n- Imagine opening nested boxes: each box contains a smaller box, until you reach the tiny box with the prize.\n- A recursive process needs a stopping rule, so it knows when to stop opening boxes and return the answers."}
